title: Existence part of the balancing universal property
statement: Existence part of the balancing universal property. This is the corresponding clause of the parent universal property with all displayed hypotheses unchanged.

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma 01SB (morphisms-lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), change of rings assertion; Sheaves, Lemma 0089 (sheaves-lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules); explicit tensor-balancing argument in steps 1-4 of lem-weil-pbc-change-of-rings-tensor-relation-presentation

proof.text: Evaluate a followed by f = d followed by f on b tensor (c tensor p). The assumed action formulas give f(phi(b)c tensor p) = f(c tensor bp). The pairing h(c,p)=f(tmulSection c p) is additive in both variables by the tensor-section addition formulas. Mathlib TensorProduct.liftAddHom and liftAddHom_tmul give the additive map from each sectionwise B-tensor product into Q.

Give the additive lift its O_Y(W)-linear structure by TensorProduct.induction_on. On a pure tensor, restricted O-scalar multiplication acts on c through C.hom; smul_tmulSection and linearity of f give the required equality. Zero and sums follow from additivity. Check naturality by the same tensor induction: the characterization of changeOfRingsMap on pure tensors, tmulSection_map, and naturality of f give the pure-tensor case. These linear maps define the presheaf morphism k from the O-restriction of changeOfRingsPresheaf to Q.val.

Restrict the change-of-rings sheafification unit to obtain eta:K->T.val over O_Y. Its underlying additive presheaf map is still CategoryTheory.toSheafify, hence locally injective and locally surjective. Apply Mathlib PresheafOfModules.homEquivOfIsLocallyBijective eta Q.isSheaf to k to obtain t.val and eta followed by t.val=k; package it as the sheaf morphism t:T->Q. This invokes the locally bijective universal property directly, so no C-action on Q and no separate comparison isomorphism are needed.

To prove g followed by t=f, precompose with the inverse tensorObjIsoSheafification and apply injectivity of the sheafification adjunction hom equivalence. Presheaf morphism extensionality and ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext reduce equality to c tensor p. The formula for g identifies its value with eta(c tensor_B p); eta followed by t.val=k and liftAddHom_tmul identify the composite with f(tmulSection c p). This is the desired equality. All constructions and inductions apply also to empty opens and zero modules.

lean.statement:
theorem changeOfRings_tensor_balancing_universal_exists (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (φ : B ⟶ C)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B.right)) :
    let P₀ := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P
    let S := tensorObj C.toModule P₀
    let T := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 C.hom)).obj
      (SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} φ.right P)
    ∀ (a d : tensorObj B.toModule S ⟶ S) (g : S ⟶ T),
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W))
          (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        a.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule)
          b (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p)) =
          tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c (b • p)) →
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W))
          (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        d.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule)
          b (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p)) =
          tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀)
            (φ.right.hom.app (op W) b * c) p) →
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        g.app W (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p) =
          (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
            (𝟙 (𝓡 C.right).obj)).unit.app
            (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} φ.right P)).app
              (op W))
              (c ⊗ₜ[B.right.obj.obj (op W), (φ.right.hom.app (op W)).hom] p)) →
      ∀ (Q : Y.Modules) (f : S ⟶ Q), a ≫ f = d ≫ f → ∃ t : T ⟶ Q, g ≫ t = f
